scripts.prod: npm run build && cross-env DEV_WITH_PROD_PAGES=1 electron .
scripts.pack:x86_64-pc-windows-msvc: npm run build:pack -- --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:aarch64-pc-windows-msvc: npm run build:pack -- --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc && electron-builder --win --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu: npm run build:pack -- --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu: npm run build:pack -- --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && electron-builder --linux --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:x86_64-apple-darwin: npm run build:pack -- --target x86_64-apple-darwin && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:aarch64-apple-darwin: npm run build:pack -- --target aarch64-apple-darwin && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
